question: The all-India poverty ratio was found to be ______ as per the Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**25.01%**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Multidimensional Poverty** Means a person is not just one-dimensionally poor but is poor in **many dimensions**.
 
• The Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) is based on **three dimensions:-**
 
 
• ** Health, Education, and Standard of living.**
 
 
 
• The Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) has been released by** Niti Aayog **every year.
 
• The MPI report identifies **25.01%** of India’s population as **multidimensionally poor.**
